publication_mismatch.landscape_page_is_correct: The public landscape page (xsonomy.com/data/landscape.json) contains exactly the 375 verified-and-live companies. An independent check of 253 excluded/needs_review records found ZERO of them present in the landscape. The landscape gate works.
publication_mismatch.what_the_292_actually_means: These are live in the WIDER general catalogue (companies.json, about 2,300 companies), not on the landscape page. Being out of scope for the europe-uav-cuas landscape is not by itself a reason to unpublish a legitimate company from a site-wide catalogue. Of the 292, roughly 21 carry screening notes identifying them as non-companies or entity-extraction errors (procurement platforms, publications, NGOs, accelerators, universities, product lines); the rest are real companies in other industries.
publication_mismatch.correction: Batches 10-14 reported the growing number as companies wrongly on xsonomy.com. That framing was wrong: the landscape page never showed them. The genuine one-sided gap is the 158 verified companies that are NOT on the landscape page.
